import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,sys
p=Path.cwd()
def write(n,s):subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(p/'write_lane.py'),n],input=s,text=True,check=True)
write('src/URMatchingAvoidanceCountAxioms.lean','module\npublic import URMatchingAvoidanceCount\n#print axioms URMatching.restriction_fiber_card\n#print axioms URMatching.avoidingEmbeddingEquiv\n#print axioms URMatching.one_colour_avoidance_count\n')
s='''module
public import URMatchingAvoidanceCount
public import URMatchingAvoidanceProduct
public import Mathlib.Data.Nat.Factorial.BigOperators
@[expose] public section
namespace URMatching
open scoped Classical
/-- Actual one-permutation avoidance bound; all denominators cleared. -/
theorem one_colour_avoidance_bound {N : ℕ} (A B : Finset (Fin N))
    (hab : A.card ≤ N - B.card) (hb : N ≤ 4 * B.card) :
    4 ^ A.card * Fintype.card {σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin N) // AvoidsRectangle A B σ} ≤
      3 ^ A.card * N.factorial := by
  classical
  have hbN : B.card ≤ N := by simpa using B.card_le_univ
  have haN : A.card ≤ N := by simpa using A.card_le_univ
  have h := avoidance_product_bound N B.card A.card hab hbN hb
  rw [← Nat.descFactorial_eq_prod_range, ← Nat.descFactorial_eq_prod_range] at h
  rw [one_colour_avoidance_count]
  have hh := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (N - A.card).factorial h
  simpa only [Nat.mul_assoc, Nat.mul_comm (N - A.card).factorial,
    ← Nat.mul_assoc, Nat.factorial_mul_descFactorial haN] using hh

/-- The fixed rectangle bound on the actual unconditioned 100-permutation space. -/
theorem hundred_colour_avoidance_bound {N : ℕ} (A B : Finset (Fin N))
    (hab : A.card ≤ N - B.card) (hb : N ≤ 4 * B.card) :
    (4 ^ A.card) ^ 100 *
      Fintype.card {f : PermutationTuples N 100 // ∀ c, AvoidsRectangle A B (f c)} ≤
      (3 ^ A.card) ^ 100 * N.factorial ^ 100 := by
  classical
  rw [hundred_color_avoidance_count]
  simpa only [Nat.mul_pow] using
    (Nat.pow_le_pow_left (one_colour_avoidance_bound A B hab hb) 100)
end URMatching
''';write('src/URMatchingAvoidanceBound.lean',s)
